name: node-to-node matching principle
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 不同离散子结构在连接位置要求节点相互对应的建模原则。

complete_examples.text: As the modelling advancement, the versatility for FEM construction of track-subgrade systems has been promoted, where the elemental scale can be arbitrarily chosen without consideration of the node-to-node matching principle as the conventional methods; besides the vehicle and the track-subgrade systems have been coupled effectively by wheel-rail contact models.
